generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner.
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt., orders as may be modified from time to time.
Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected.
Earnest Money Deposit will have to be in any one of the forms as per the instructions in the financial bid document and shall have to be valid for 45 days beyond the validity of the tender.

All formats prescribed in the bid documents shall be filled in complete manner (section 2 & of the bid document)and shall be uploaded properly, signed by tenderer. Necessary certificates shall be uploaded along with the formats wherever required. General documents section can be used for this purpose
Tenderers are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid

If the tenderer quotes bid price below the estimated contract value (Amount put to tender) then the tenderer has to submit the additional security deposit equal to the difference in cost and the additional security deposit should have a validity for the period of execution.

If the numbers of page to be attached in one particular attachment is more, then all the pages can be put into one folder, zipped and then attached or else all the pages can be pasted in one word file and then this word file could be converted to PDF (portable documents format) format and then attached. (Please contract help desk from 9.00 AM to 9.00 PM (Monday to Saturday) Ph No: 91-8046010000 and 91-8068948777 or send query through Karnataka public procurement portal through query option on or before specified time.

The Contractor shall strictly take all reasonable steps to protect the environment on and off the site and to avoid damage or nuisance to persons or to property of the public or others resulting from pollution, noise or other causes arising as a consequence of his methods of operation.

Materials like, steel (primary), cement, bitumen etc., required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should be got tested positive by the quality control authority before use on the work.
Tenderer should have latest GST Registration and latest clearance certificate in their name
The Rates quoted by the tenderer shall be exclusive of GST.
Special Instructions to tenderers - as per bid document.
The Defects Liability Period is 1 year from the date of completion of the work.
Total value of Civil Engineering Construction works executed in the and payments received in the last five year i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26

The Tenderers are bound to furnish the original certified documents to the employer within 3 days from the day of opening of technical bid for verification, failing which the bid of tenderer will be considered as technically non responsive.

The Work done certificate should be issued by the Officer not less than the rank of Executive Engineer of State or Central Government/ Semi Government/Government undertaking/ autonomous bodies of Government will be considered for the clause 3.2 (b)(c)(d)and (e).
As per GO No:FD-CAM/16/2022 (P-2) dated 22nd August 2022 , Banker Certificate / Line of credit shall be uploaded in the format mentioned in the SECTION -11 as per bid document
Tenderer should have EPF and ESI Registration certificate in their name

Clause ITT 3.2(a): To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in his/its name should have in the last five years i.e.(2021-22 to 2025-26) The tenderer should have been achieved in at least two financial years a minimum annual financial turnover (in all classes of civil Engineering construction works only) of Rs. 49.78 Lakhs. Note : a) For Clause 3.2 (a) the certificate duly certified by the charted accountant is to be submitted

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: Clause 3.2(c) To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in his/its name should have in the last five years i.e.(2021-22 to 2025-26). Executed in any one year, the following minimum quantities of work 1 G I Roof sheet 1200 Sqm 2 Steel and Aluminium work 10100 Kg 3 Painting 11650 Sqm. Note-The Work done certificate should be issued by the Officer not less than the rank of Executive Engineer of State or Central Government/ Semi Government/Government undertaking/ autonomous bodies of Government will be considered

The Tenderer or his identified sub contractor should possess required valid electrical license for executing building electrification works issued by KPWD/Government Electrical Inspectorate and should have executed similar building electrical works totaling Rs. 0.00 Lakhs in any one financial year Note:Consent letter of the subcontractor should be uploaded

The Tenderer or his identified sub-contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply/sanitary engineering works issued by BWSSB/KUWS&DB and should possess valid licence for executing water supply or sanitary engineering works issued by competent authority and should have executed similar water supply or sanitary engineering works total Rs. 0.00 Lakh in any one financial year, Note:Consent letter of the sub contractor should be uploaded

Clause ITT 3.2(b)To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in his/its name should have in the last five years i.e.(2021-22 to 2025-26) The tenderer should have been Satisfactorily completed at least one similar nature of work of value not less than Rs. 24.90 Lakhs as prime contractor. Note : The Work done certificate should be issued by the Officer not less than the rank of Executive Engineer of State or Central Government/ Semi Government/Government undertaking/ autonomous bodies of Government will be considered for the clause 3.2 (b).

Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under: Assessed available ender capacity (AxNx2.5 - B) where A Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years 2021-22 to 2025-26 (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited. B Value, at 2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 4 months (period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited4

itemList.description: Providing and fixing precoated galvanised iron profile sheets (size, shape and pitch of corrugation as approved by Engineer-in-charge) 0.50 mm (+ 0.05 %) total coated thickness with zinc coating 120 g/m2  as per IS: 277, in 240 mpa steel grade, 5-7 microns epoxy primer on both side of the sheet and polyester top coat 15-18 microns. Sheet should have protective guard film of 25 microns minimum to avoid scratches during transportation and should be supplied in single length upto 12 m or as desired by Engineer- in-charge. The sheet shall be fixed using self drilling/self tapping screws of size (5.5x 55 mm) with EPDM seal, complete upto any pitch in horizontal/ vertical or curved surfaces, excluding the cost of purlins, rafters and trusses and including cutting to size and shape wherever required.

Providing and fixing   Steel work in built up tubular (round, square or rectangular  hollow  tubes  etc.)  trusses  etc.,  including  cutting,  hoisting, fixing in position and applying a priming coat of approved steel primer, including welding and bolted with special shaped washers etc. complete. Hot finished welded type tubes  including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in-Charge.

Finishing walls with 100% Premium acrylic emulsion paint having VOC less  than   50   g/L and   UV   resistance   as   per   IS 15489:2004,  Alkali &    fungal resistance, dirt resistance exterior paint   of   required   shade (Company  Depot  Tinted)  with  silicon additives, New work (Two coats applied  @  1.43  L/  10  m².  Over  and  including  priming  coat  of  exterior primer applied @ 0.90  L/10 m²  with paint of approved quality to give an even shade, after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Finishing   walls   with   Premium   Acrylic   Smooth   exterior   paint with Silicone  additives  with  pure  Acrylic  Resin,  UV  resistant,  dirt  &  pick  up resistant,  Alkali  &  Water  resistant  of  required  shade:  New  work  (Two coats applied @ 1.43 L/10 m² over and including priming coat of exterior primer applied @ 2.20 kg/10 m²)  with paint of approved quality to give an even shade, after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar  drops and foreign matter  including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Painting   with   synthetic   enamel   paint   of   approved   brand   and manufacture  to  give  an  even  shade  :Two  coats  on  new  work   after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.
